newsitem.title: ECUADOR: U.S. teacher dies in Ecuador after bus holdup.
newsitem.headline: U.S. teacher dies in Ecuador after bus holdup.

text.p: A 54-year-old American woman died on Friday in an Ecuadorean hospital after being shot by highwaymen holding up a bus in the port city of Guayaquil, police said.
Aida Elena Gerdes, a University of New Mexico librarian, was travelling to a local beach with 15 University of New Mexico students when six robbers stopped their bus on a highway on Thursday night.
The U.S. Embassy is arranging for the repatriation of Gerdes' body, police said.
